Type: white six-drawer dresser
Use: storing clothes and linens, top for a mirror, lamps and decor; bedroom, guest room
Style: classic, traditional, farmhouse
Materials: white painted wood and fiberboard, polished metal bow handles
Colors: bright white, silver
Shape: wide low dresser with two columns of three drawers, inset panel fronts with curved metal handles, softly molded top edge and base, short turned tapered feet, medium visual weight
Feel: graceful, fresh, elegant, serene

product.description: Of course your home should be a safe place for the entire family. Thats why a safety fitting is included so that you can attach the chest of drawers to the wall.
